item.title: Restricted and Undocumented oradebug Commands
item.description:
After an investigation into how to bypass restricted oradebug commands (see also source 1), I started wondering whether a complete list of restricted commands exists, or whether there is any way to reliably identify them. Unfortunately, no such list is available, so I decided to take a closer look at the internal structures that oradebug uses under the hood.

To my surprise, I discovered that oradebug not only has restricted commands, but also a number of undocumented commands that are not shown in the oradebug help output.

item.title: Extracting Fixed View Definitions From The Oracle Binary
item.description:
If you’ve ever needed to look up the definition of a dynamic performance view in Oracle, also referred to as a fixed view, or simply a V$ view, chances are that you’ve come across V$FIXED_VIEW_DEFINITION.
